# The Proud Paintbrush

> The Proud Paintbrush LLC is a locally owned residential and light commercial painting contractor in Sugar Land, TX, founded in 2020 by Chris Petkau. We paint interiors, exteriors and cabinets, repair drywall and stain fences across Fort Bend County and West Houston. Every job uses a prep-first process and comes with a 2 & 5-Year Written Warranty. Fully Insured · $1M Liability. Sherwin-Williams paint partner. 5.0★ Google rating.

- Phone: (832) 605-0493
- Email: sales@theproudpaintbrush.com
- Location: Sugar Land, TX 77498
- Service areas: Sugar Land, Missouri City, Katy, Richmond, Rosenberg, Fulshear, West Houston, Southwest Houston
- Free on-site estimates: https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/book

## Services

- [Interior painting](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/interior-painting): walls, ceilings, trim, doors and whole-home repaints
- [Exterior painting](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/exterior-painting): siding, stucco, brick, trim, doors and garage doors built for Gulf Coast heat and humidity
- [Cabinet painting](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/cabinet-painting): kitchen and bathroom cabinet refinishing
- [Drywall repair](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/interior-painting/drywall-repair): patches, texture matching and prep for paint
- [Fence staining](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/exterior-painting/fence-staining): wood fence cleaning, staining and sealing
- [Commercial painting](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/commercial-painting)
- [Color consultation](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/color-consultation)
- [All services](https://www.theproudpaintbrush.com/services)
